_doc: Canonical trigger-class config for the prospect-dossier why-now slot (spec 4.2). Single source of truth. filler-2-why-now.DRAFT.js (the filler) and filler-coverage-gate.DRAFT.js (the gate) each carry an inline copy that MUST equal this file. At integration, prefer wiring both nodes to read this (n8n workflow static data or a Set node) over hand-syncing. Resolves consistency-review conflicts 2, 3, 4.
_pre_gate: DRAFT, not applied. No deploy authorised here.

strength_rule._doc: Single definition of slot-2 (why_now) evidence_strength. Applied at scoring time by filler-6-qualification. The gate (filler-coverage-gate) only needs strength != none, so it treats any grounded why_now as not-none.
strength_rule.explicit: why_now_source is an http(s) URL (a real news permalink)
strength_rule.inferred: why_now_source is a synthetic steam: token (steam:release_date, steam:appreviews-velocity)

decay_ownership: why_now_decay_weight is the slot-2 (why_now) decay column. evidence_decay_weight is the slot-3 (demand) decay column. The two slots never share a decay column (consistency-review conflict 1).
